name: Spirit Ranger
summary: A mystic wilderness guardian who communes with nature spirits for omens and unprepared Ranger magic.

features.name: Spirit Bond
features.summary: In favored terrain, use augury and spontaneously cast one Ranger spell you are capable of casting without preparing it.
features.scaling: one additional spontaneous Ranger spell at 8th and every 4 levels

features.name: Wisdom of the Spirits
features.summary: Use augury outside favored terrain or divination while within favored terrain, at a caster level equal to Ranger level.
